The structure of Cs6In2Br6 (reduced formula Cs3InBr3) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 14 atoms per unit cell across three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Br centers coordinated by two Cs atoms, In centers by six Br atoms in an octahedral motif, and Cs centers by six neighbors (three Br and three In). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component, and validated polyhedron contacts include edge-sharing between Br 2-vertex polyhedra and corner- and edge-sharing between Cs and In polyhedra.
